ache.title: “Going ALL IN” for Edda. Look at him go
ache.note: A whole pull session of past-Nero going all out for Edda, asking if his perseverance will pay off. Watching pulls is fun because someone else’s luck feels like your own chance. “All in” and “perseverance” are just nicer words for chasing. Gacha luck doesn’t reward trying harder; it only takes more.
watch: pull videos that make you want yours
ache.tip: If a pull video makes you want to pull too, close it and do something with your hands for ten minutes.
lines: all in. what’s left after all in?
perseverance is for marathons, not banners
watching someone pull is still the loop

title: Pulling for Edda, and going ALL IN | Sword of Convallaria
excerpt: Inside the Loop: I made this while I was caught in the gacha loop. It stays up as a record of that time, not as advice. Join me in this intense gacha session where I go all out for Edda! I love her fantasy-themed design and strong support skills. Watch as I navigate through my pulls and share my reactions along the way. Will my perseverance pay off? Tune in to find out!
